meta.generatedFrom: TypeScript (the parity contract — never regenerate from Rust)
meta.description: Every combination of boundary-adjacent s, sPrev, innovation and shock values, one step each. The dense grid is the contract; `nonFinite` documents JS behaviour on NaN/Infinity inputs.
notes: ORDER OF OPERATIONS IS PART OF THE CONTRACT: next = ((MISPRICING_PHI * s + momentum) + innovation) + shock, evaluated strictly left to right. Any reassociation or fused multiply-add changes the last bit. The Rust port must not use mul_add here.
momentum = MOMENTUM_THETA * (s - sPrev) is computed BEFORE the sum, from the UNCLAMPED s and sPrev.
shock is clamped to ±DAILY_SHOCK_CAP first; innovation is NOT clamped at all.
sPrev of the returned state is the INPUT s, unclamped — so a state constructed by hand with |s| > cap propagates that value into sPrev exactly once.

This file uses a ROW TABLE rather than one object per case, purely for size. `columns` names the six positions; every entry is an f64 bit pattern. `decimalPreview` repeats the first 48 rows in object form.
meta.floatEncoding: bits = raw IEEE-754 f64, big-endian, 16 uppercase hex digits. dec = shortest round-trip decimal, informational only.
meta.nanPolicy: Every NaN is recorded as 7FF8000000000000 (the pattern of Rust f64::NAN). V8 does not emit a stable NaN sign/payload, so only NaN-ness is contractual — compare NaN results with is_nan(), not with bits.
